'''All Knights''' is a Latin American esports organization founded in October 2018 by Felipe Rossi and Javier Corral with the intention of improving the level of Latin America.

== History ==
The team was founded to compete in the [[Liga Latinoamérica]], the new unified Latin American league started in 2019, being the only squad selected without previously being part of neither the [[Liga Latinoamérica Norte|CLN]] nor the [[Copa Latinoamérica Sur|CLS]].

During their competitive history, they were crowned once as Latin American champions.<ref>[https://lolesports.com/article/medallero-hist-rico-en-latinoam-rica/blt92678f1a0ecf8cf6 Medallero histórico en Latinoamérica (Spanish)] ''lolesports.com''</ref>

==Trivia==
* Known for being the first Latin American team to bring Korean players to [[LLA]].
